summary: Frontend-only verification of three related changes: (A) Meals Daily-entry collapse-on-entry, (B) unit-aware qty decimals across meal screens + Stock Master, (C) Task Manager To-dos regression after HeatStrip/TodoRow component extraction. All three PASS visually + via data-testid probes.
action_items: None from a functional standpoint — all three changes verified.

ENV NOTE (not caused by this change): The exec.test@example.com / dar.test@example.com test users are documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md but are NOT seeded by the backend startup routine — the users collection in the preview DB had them missing. Testing agent had to re-seed exec.test manually (users doc + rules_acceptances). Consider adding an idempotent seed for these two accounts in _seed_database so future iterations don't hit the same wall.
critical_code_review_comments: utils.fmtQty correctly uses en-IN locale with min/maxFractionDigits=1 for weight/volume (guarantees trailing .0) and 0 for count units — matches requirement precisely.

MealEntryTab.jsx didInitCollapse useRef pattern ensures collapse-on-entry fires exactly once after cats load — and because collapsedCats is initialised from localStorage, subsequent expands are still persisted across renders within the same session. Confirmed collapsed state also survives leaving the /admin/meals-report route and coming back (component unmounts → didInitCollapse resets → re-collapses all cats, which matches the requested 'each time you enter the tab' behaviour).

MealEntryTab still writes to localStorage 'mealEntry.collapsedCats' on toggle but overwrites it on remount via the init effect — the localStorage read on mount is effectively ignored. Harmless but dead code.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@attendance.app / Admin@12345 (works). Executive: exec.test@example.com / Exec@12345 — had to be re-seeded via direct DB insert (see action_items). Rules acceptance also seeded for this user.
seed_data_creation: Inserted users doc for exec.test@example.com (bcrypt Exec@12345, role=member, category=executive) and a rules_acceptances doc for version 2026-09 so /tasks is reachable without the /rules gate.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Meals Daily-entry categories are collapsed by default on every mount via didInitCollapse useRef. Unit-decimal rules live in /app/frontend/src/utils.js fmtQty(); COUNT_UNITS covers pc/pcs/pkt/dozen/tray/etc. If you see a count-unit item still showing a decimal, double-check the item's `unit` string matches the whitelist (case-insensitive, trimmed). Task Manager /tasks?tab=todos requires the exec test user to (a) exist and (b) have a rules_acceptances row for the current version, otherwise the route redirects to /rules.

verification_details.A_collapse_on_entry: 7 category headers visible, entry-row-* count on load = 0. Navigated away to /admin and back to /admin/meals-report — still 0 visible rows on re-entry. PASS.
verification_details.B_unit_decimals: Stock Master screenshot verified: Guava/Orange/Papaya (KG) → 12.1, 0.0, 12.6; Almonds (KG) → 2.0/0.4/1.6 (trailing zero preserved); Atta (KG) → 0.0/15.0/-15.0; Apple/Pineapple (PC) → 16/8 whole; Banana (DO=dozen) → 26/5/21 whole; Bread (PA=pack) → 21/12/9 whole. Rates/amounts all show 2 decimals (₹1,823.29, ₹1,131.90, ₹1,852.61).
verification_details.C_task_manager: heatstrip present, heat-day-2026-09-11 … heat-day-2026-09-17 (7 days). Clicking heat-day-2026-09-14 applies ring-2 ring-indigo-500 and date bar switches to 'Mon, 14 Sept 2026'. Tabs today/todos/checklists all rendered. Todo row shows todo-toggle, todo-edit-btn, todo-comments-btn, todo-take. Delete is only shown to creators (row was authored by another user) — expected. Clicking edit reveals inline edit form with Save/Cancel. No console errors during flow.
